public_summary: Aligned resource GET measurement with the public JSON catalog using a generated exact allowlist and record-kind aggregation. Retained query/identifier exclusion, test separation, 90-day retention and existing publication suppression. Public referring domains remain browser-event-only. JSON retrieval is not evidence of AI identity, discovery or useful reuse; older unobserved requests are not backfilled.

public_summary: Implemented a separate exact whole-week export from existing retained integer aggregates, excluding marked tests and all source/page/daily breakdowns. No production exact totals have been read from this environment; no historical article counts were replaced. Clarified the next usefulness trial to reject comparisons where all baseline tasks already succeed.
